A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the creep mechanism of SAC(307)-In alloys is controlled by the climb-controlled dislocations enhanced by pipe diffusion, and the grain refinement after RMF application is the major factor that contributes to the creep mechanism.
the creep mechanism is dominated by the dislocation climb-controlled pipe diffusion mechanism at the strain rate of 10−6 s−1 and temperature range of 150–175 °C.
the creep mechanisms of SAC(307)-xIn alloys are controlled by dislocation climb with pipe diffusion, and the activation energies and stress exponents are reduced by the grain refinement after RMF.
